test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the set of classes the relationship among which is best illustrated by the following Venn diagram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a33556c76ee1c1ec5f6b1d84edf9e4e9a27da703526b1ddb5f21266c6dba095.png]
solution:
Venn diagram according to the given information:

Books, Kitchens and Cars. These three have no relationship between each other.

So, they are represented by three disjoint circles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f87002ef447e3fc0cc724ff527a65233fa304796581a98b74e31e76a6049277.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Books, Kitchens and Cars".**
